svg.title: N for Neon and LED Sign Design
svg.desc: A 6.5-second looping animation. An N on a sign panel lights up as a neon tube is drawn and a column of LED bulbs turns on in sequence. It introduces neon and LED sign design with illustrative neon, LED display and store signage examples.
svg.metadata: 1920 by 1080; 16:9; 6.5-second loop; reimagines the teal, cream, coral and black palette of 14_N_naming.png; no external assets. Sign concepts are illustrative.

g.text: LIGHT UP THE BRAND. STAND OUT AFTER DARK.
